title: Offline invoice CSV totals CLI
source_request: Build a usable local Python 3.12 CLI for freelancers. Read a UTF-8 CSV file with date, client, and amount columns, then print JSON totals per client using exact decimal arithmetic. Reject missing columns and invalid amounts with a nonzero exit and useful stderr. Include tests and a README covering setup, usage, tests, and limits. Use no network service or credentials.
requirements: Expose python -m invoice_totals PATH --json as the command-line entry point.
Read a UTF-8 CSV file with date, client, and amount columns, and sum amounts per client using decimal arithmetic.
Print one JSON object with a totals object mapping each client to a two-decimal string.
Reject missing required columns, invalid decimal amounts, and missing files with a nonzero exit and useful stderr, without success JSON.
Provide pytest coverage and a README with installation, usage, tests, and limitations.

acceptance_criteria.description: Valid CSV inputs yield exact decimal totals per client.
Malformed CSV, invalid amounts, and missing files fail cleanly.
The package compiles, passes Ruff and pytest, and has usable documentation.

constraints: Use Python 3.12 and the standard library at runtime.
Keep code, tests, and documentation in the supplied repository.
Do not access the network or a hosted service.
assumptions: Input invoices fit into memory and each amount uses a period as decimal separator.
